**HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 is the third release candidate:** rc.2 plus a Debug tab, map points a unit can fill in on its own, a Canadian Ioniq 6 map and fixes. **The Debug tab hasn't been tried on a car yet**, so this rc is for testing. If you'd rather wait, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release.

It comes with the same mods as rc.2: **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-rc.3](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.3)** and **ADB [1.0.1-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1-rc.1)**.

## What's new since 1.1.0-rc.2

- **A Debug tab**, off until HMG-API app → Settings → About → **Show the Debug tab**:
  - **Dumps to a USB stick** (folder "HMG-API debug"): system info (dumpsys, properties, processes, mounts), logs (every logcat buffer, dmesg, crashes, HMG-API's and NEMESIS's logs, optionally with 60 s recorded live), and the apps (system, framework and installed APKs, with md5s). These can hold personal data (phone numbers, device names, accounts), so keep them to yourself. For HMG-API's maintainers, use the Car Report.
  - **Leftovers:** finds the data, APKs, libraries and optimised code of apps that aren't installed any more, and links that point at nothing, and removes what no installed app owns.
  - **MICOM recorder:** start, stop and view a recording of the car's controller messages (listening only).
  - **Clear HMG-API's data:** like uninstalling with `PURGE`, but HMG-API stays installed. Every mod's changes go back to stock, every mod is removed with its app, and HMG-API's settings, logs and reports are deleted. It can't be undone: your mods have to be installed again.
- **A unit fills in the hook points its map lacks only because the map is older than them**, after each install or update, or from Settings → "Map the points HMG-API's map lacks". Each point is checked in the car's own apps first. You can turn this off in Settings ("Use points mapped on this car").
- **"Map this car from its files" survives updates**, and works on a car whose map doesn't fit.
- **Canadian Ioniq 6 (CEEV) 260206 map**, with 351 hook points, all verified on the car.
- **The 2022 Ioniq 5 (NEEV) on US 260903** uses the 260903 map.
- **The USB install puts the HMG-API app in right away** (#187).
- Mods: a mod's NEMESIS package depends on the mods it requires; `"conflicts"` hold for mods that only hook; a mod whose `"requires"` aren't met isn't loaded.
- The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-rc.3/CHANGELOG.md).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x, the beta, rc.1 or rc.2:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Then restart the head unit once. Your mods and settings stay.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** as in [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- The app shows **1.1.0-rc.3** and "Hooks on". Your mods still run after the update and a restart.
- **Debug tab:** turn it on in Settings → About. With a USB stick in, try System info, Logs and Apps: each makes a folder in "HMG-API debug" on the stick. Run **Scan** under Leftovers and check the list before removing anything.
- **Clear HMG-API's data** only on a unit where you're happy to install your mods again: afterwards, restart. The head unit should start normally, with HMG-API and no mods.
- The rest as in [rc.2's notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.2).

## Known issues

- As in rc.2: with Android Auto's turns in the car's own format, on-ramps still show the projection icon (wireless #30). A USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting. Take the stick out after a dump.

## Going back to 1.0.2

As in [rc.2's notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.2#going-back-to-102).

## Reporting

A [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report), or [open an issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with your car, the head unit software (e.g. 260507), the HMG-API version (1.1.0-rc.3) and what happened. Please don't attach Debug dumps or post your VIN, serial numbers or phone numbers.
